text:
Ethan: Heads-up  noticing an odd reconnect pattern this morning around 2026-03-21T07:12Z. Clients report resume_ok then immediate reconnects and we get a flurry of short-lived sessions. Anyone seen a soft-ack race like this? :thinking:

maria: Yep, saw it in staging. Looks like the proxy sends a 202 (Accepted/soft-ack) during subprotocol negotiation while the route_manager rotates the replica set. Client libs treat 202 as "keepalive accepted" and continue, but when the next frame arrives the server rejects with `403 session_mismatch` and they reconnect.

Lena: That's new wording vs the normal 204/200 cases. Sample sanitized trace:```
2026-03-21T07:12:01.101Z route=chat proto=subproto-v2 session=qqq1 status=202 soft_ack=true subproto=proto-a
2026-03-21T07:12:01.188Z route=chat proto=subproto-v2 session=qqq1 frame=init payload="..." error=403 reason=\"session_mismatch\" replica_set=rs-17->rs-20
```

ara: Root cause appears to be an atomicity gap: route_manager performs `swap_replicas` which updates `replica_version` but the proxy earlier responded with soft_ack before the commit propagated to the runtime. Clients get inconsistent state.

Sam: Billing saw ~1.1k duplicate session starts in the 5m window. We should consider a short metering dedupe keyed on `resume_token` and `replica_version` within a 700ms window to avoid charging churn that is rollout-related. Gate it per-account.

Ethan: Console visibility issue: alerts just show class `unexpected_reconnect` with a sample log. We need rollout context (replica_version diff, route_change_id, canary_pct) in the alert payload so oncall can tell if a rollout caused it.

Lena: Agreed. Proposal: 1) proxy emits header `X-Replica-Change: in-flight` on soft-acks when a replica swap is pending, and structured logs include `replica_change_id` and `replica_from`/`replica_to`. 2) telemetry adds `replica_version_before` and `replica_version_after` on reconnect events.

ara: I can add the header and log fields in the proxy path. Will gate via env flag `PROXY_REPLICA_ANNOTATE`. Also add a unit test to simulate concurrent swap. ETA 35m.

maria: Client UX: DevEx should recommend clients treat `202 soft_ack` with `X-Replica-Change: in-flight` as retryable-with-resume (don't drop resume_token and backoff). We'll add code snippets for JS/Go libs.

Sam: Billing mitigation: prototype an opt-in grace window (default 700ms) where reconnects with same `resume_token` and `replica_change_id` are considered continuation, not new session for metering. We'll simulate against the spike to ensure revenue delta is small.

Ethan: Console dashboard ask: add `reconnect_by_replica_change` panel that slices reconnects by `replica_change_id` and `canary_pct`, plus an alert that enriches the payload with `route_change_commit` and `affected_slabs`.

Lena: I'll build the panel and update the alert template to include `replica_change_id` and `route_change_commit`. Also add a filter to hide alerts labeled `hand_off=planned` by default.

ara: PR #824 will include header, `replica_change_id`, and logs. I'll also emit `handoff_hint=replica_swap` when applicable. ETA 35m; rolling canary off by default.

ops-bot: note: created incident INC-2026-900 to track duplicate metering + visibility work.

Sam: Action items recap: 1) @ara add proxy header + structured logs, 2) @Lena add dashboard + alert enrichment, 3) @Sam prototype metering grace keyed by resume_token+replica_change_id, 4) DevEx publish client guidance and code snippets, 5) update rollout playbook to auto-pause on reconnect-rate threshold.

maria: One more ask  can we include `same_resume_within_ms` in reconnect telemetry so we can quickly tune the grace window without guessing?

Ethan: Good idea. Add that metric. If anyone sees immediate churn ping me and I'll drop the canary to 0%. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
